facts.text: Andrew finds hiking to be a refreshing activity that helps him feel relaxed and calms his mind.

evidence.quote: Being out in nature with all the trees and fresh air always refreshes me.
Nature really calms me down and relaxes my mind.

facts.text: Audrey agrees with Andrew that being in nature helps to alleviate worries and provides a sense of accomplishment.

evidence.quote: It's like you've achieved something and all worries just fade away.

facts.text: Audrey mentions that her pets are her companions and bring her joy, especially during tough times.

evidence.quote: My pets have been my good ol' buddies during all the tough times! They make me so happy and I love them so much.

facts.text: Audrey believes that sharing outdoor activities with someone special enhances the experience and brings joy and love.

evidence.quote: Sharing something you enjoy with someone is great. Plus, those types of bonds bring loads of joy and love.
